Instead, active items are now charged when enemies take damage from any source.

Charges are gained at a rate of 40 + 20 × CurrentStage. For example, in Basement I it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge, while in Home it takes 300 damage.

If an enemy receives more damage than their maximum amount of health, the excess amount will not be counted towards the recharge formula.

synergies.description: Spawns an electrical cyan locust that has a chance to chain-zap enemies similar to the effects of Jacob's Ladder. Zaps deal 0.1 damage.

name: Fruity Plum
description:
Spawns a familiar that mimics Baby Plum's attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room.

The familiar deals 2 damage per tick (8.57 per second). It fires 15 tears per second while moving which deal 3 damage each.

The familiar will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.

If there are no enemies in the room, the familiar will loosely orbit Isaac.

synergies.description: ×2 contact and tear damage.

name: Plum Flute
description:
Summons a friendly version of Baby Plum that fights for Isaac in the current room for 10 seconds.

The familiar will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before flying away.

The familiar deals 12 contact damage per tick (36 per second), 5 when jumping in place, 3.5 per shot, 3-4 per shot while bouncing diagonally, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).

Can be obtained by using its unlock method.
unlock: Spare Baby Plum's life by waiting enough time instead of defeating her.

synergies.description: ×2 contact damage.

Spawns a wisp on the middle ring that resembles Baby Plum. When the familiar spawned from Plum Flute bounces diagonally around the room, all the wisps will bounce around the room and fire tears behind themselves as well. They are invulnerable while doing so.

unlock_text: Spare Baby Plum's life by waiting enough time instead of defeating her.

name: Star of Bethlehem
description:
Spawns a glowing star that slowly travels towards the Boss Room using the shortest possible route.

The star is surrounded with a glowing aura that gives Isaac the following when standing inside it:

• ×1.2 damage multiplier.

• ×2.5 fire rate multiplier.

• Homing tears.

• 50% chance to block damage.

Once the star reaches the Boss Room, it will center itself in the room for the rest of the floor.

The speed of the star changes based on whether Isaac is in front or behind it in correlation to the Boss Room. It will speed up if it's lacking behind, or slow down if Isaac is behind.

The star may travel through Secret Rooms and Curse Rooms on its path to the Boss Room. It may also travel through Red Rooms if they create an optimal path to the Boss Room.

With Curse of the Labyrinth! active, the star will travel to the second Boss Room.

In the Void, the star will travel to Delirium's Boss Room.

In Greed Mode, the star will always center itself in the starting room, except on the final floor, where it will move to the Ultra Greed fight.

The star won't appear in The Beast fight.

If the Mega Satan door is opened, the star will travel to that fight instead.

name: Cube Baby
description:
Spawns a frozen ice cube familiar that cannot move on its own, and requires Isaac to kick it, causing it to slide around the room and deal contact damage to enemies.

The cube can be kicked by walking into it, melee attacked, or be shot at. It can also be picked up by using Mom's Bracelet.

The familiar deals up to 11 contact damage based on how fast it's traveling, 4.29 times per second.

The familiar will slow enemies it touches while moving.

Enemies killed by the familiar are frozen, and obey the same rules as ice statues created by Uranus.

The familiar blocks enemy projectiles.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.
Spawns a blue locust that has a chance to turn enemies into ice statues upon death.

name: Vade Retro
description:
While heldEnemies leave behind small, red ghosts upon death.

On useCauses all red ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying projectiles.

The explosion cannot hurt Isaac or damage the environment.

The explosion deals damage equal to 3 + 0.04 × EnemyMaxHealth + (CurrentFloor - 1) × 0.5. Each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times.

The blast radius scales with how powerful the explosion is.

Instantly kills any enemy that has the "ghost" tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses. This can even be used to kill Delirium if it transforms into such an enemy. Enemies that are currently not visible on screen are not detonated.

Detonates Isaac's ghost after his death, dealing 200 damage to nearby enemies.

Ghosts can be slightly pushed around by shooting at them.

synergies.description: Instead of creating wisps, causes the ghosts to very slowly move and shoot tears in the same direction as Isaac, dealing 3.5 damage and shooting every second.
Instead of exploding, causes the ghosts to home in on nearby enemies and explode on contact, dealing 2x Judas' damage.

name: False PHD
description:
On pickup +1 Black Heart.

While heldIdentifies all pills.

Converts all pills into their bad counterparts, but gives them positive secondary effects. Neutral pills don't gain a secondary effect.

Stat down pills will also grant +0.6 damage, or +1.2 if it was a horse pill.

Other bad pills will drop a Black Heart.

The item's effects work retroactively, giving stat boosts for each stat down pill taken before picking up the item.

When combined with PHD or other items that convert pills, the effects neutralize themselves allowing both types of pills to exist again.

name: Spin to Win
description:
While heldSpawns a spinning wheel familiar that orbits Isaac, blocks enemy shots and deals 3.5 damage per tick (26.25 per second).

On useHolding the active item button makes the wheel spin rapidly around Isaac, giving him +0.5 speed, and increasing the contact damage of all of Isaac's familiars, even if they normally don't do any.

Orbital familiars also spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac while dealing damage.

The contact damage is boosted to 1.5 × ContactDamage + 6. If a familiar does not do contact damage normally, it still received the +6.

This means that Spin to Win deals 11.25 damage per tick (84.38 per second) while spinning.

Also affects Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, and they don't die while the item is in use.

The recharge time is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used. It can be used even when the charge bar is not full.

Isaac's effective speed can exceed the 2.0 limit, even if the HUD doesn't show it.

synergies.description: ×2 contact damage when not spinning.
Up to 8 wisps are spawned while using the item, and they are immediately destroyed when stopped using it. The wisps shoot 6 times faster than usual, but have only 0.5 HP.

name: Vasculitis
description:
Makes enemies release 1-16 friendly tears in random directions upon death. Tears appear as large red blood clots which may make them hard to distinguish from enemy projectiles. They also inherit Isaac's tear effects thus may appear in a different color.

The amount of tears released is based on the enemy's max health points.

Burst tears deal a set amount of damage: 3.2 + 0.3 × CurrentStage.

If an enemy is killed while affected by a status effect, the burst tears will inherit that status effect.

name: Giant Cell
description:
Taking damage summons a miniature Isaac familiar known as Minisaac, that chases enemies and fires tears on its own.

Minisaacs' tear damage is based on the formula: 1.20 + 0.15 × CurrentFloor.

The familiar shoots 3 times per second.

Minisaacs persist between rooms and floors.

Each Minisaac starts with 15 health points that are constantly drained with a rate of 0.4 per second, until it reaches 0.8 HP.

Whenever Isaac takes damage, all Minisaacs are healed back to their full health.

Minisaacs take damage from enemy projectiles and contact damage. They can also be damaged by Isaac's bombs.

Minisaacs are immune to spikes and lasers.

No more than 16 Minisaacs can exist at a time.

When playing as The Forgotten, a special Minisaac variant will spawn that inherits the bone club attack. This familiar deals 8.1 + 0.9 × CurrentFloor damage, and swings its bone club 1.5 times per second.

Minisaacs receive wings if Isaac has any form of flight.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Polycephalus.

synergies.description: +40% damage.

name: Tropicamide
description:
+2.5 range.

+0.22 tear size.

name: Card Reading
description:
Creates 2 portals at the beginning of each floor. They can spawn at random with different colors, each taking Isaac to a different room:

• Red: Boss Room.

• Yellow: Treasure Room.

• Blue: Secret Room.

• Green: Shop.

The portals disappear once the starting room is left.

From Chapter 4 onward, only 1 portal will spawn.

name: Quints
description:
Spawns a stationary familiar in the place of killed enemies, up to 5 per room. Familiars appear colorless.

The following familiars can be spawned:

• Abel

• Boiled Baby

• Brother Bobby

• Demon Baby

• Freezer Baby

• Ghost Baby

• Guardian Angel

• Harlequin Baby

• Lil Brimstone

• Little Steven

• Multidimensional Baby

• Robo-Baby

• Rotten Baby

• Seraphim

• Sister Maggy

The same type of familiar can spawn multiple times per room.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.

name: Tooth and Nail
description:
Causes Isaac to turn to stone and sprout spikes every 6 seconds. Isaac is immune to damage while in this state, and deals 40 damage per tick (80 per second). The effect lasts for 1 second.

Isaac will flash white 4 times before turning into stone on the 4th flash. These flashes are accompanied with a ticking sound.

Can be used to enter Curse Rooms and open Spiked Chests for free, but cannot be used to play Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars for free.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Tuff Twins.

synergies.description: Spawns a cyan locust that has a chance to destroy enemy projectiles upon contact.

name: Binge Eater
description:
On pickup +1 full Red Heart container.

Fully heals Isaac.

While heldCauses item pedestals to have an additional food item which cycles alongside the original item.

Picking up the food item grants Isaac with the following:
• +3.6 damage which fades over 30 seconds. This boost cannot be stacked and will be reset to 3.6 by picking up additional food items.

• 0.03 speed.

• A permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed.

• +1 additional red heart heal.

Stat boosts are different based on the item consumed:

• Breakfast: +0.2 shot speed, +2.5 range.

• Dessert: +1 flat damage, +0.2 shot speed.

• Dinner: +0.5 tears, +0.2 shot speed.

• Lunch: +0.5 tears, +2.5 range.

• Midnight Snack: +1 flat damage, +1 luck.

• Rotten Meat: +1 flat damage, +2.5 range.

• A Snack: +0.2 shot speed, +1 luck.

• Supper: +0.5 tears, +1 luck.

Stat boosts also work retroactively, meaning that picking up Binge Eater will grant all relevant stat boosts from food items previously collected, excluding the additional healing provided by them.

Certain item pedestals that are required to progress the game won't gain the additional food item.

name: Guppy's Eye
description:
Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.

Up to 4 contents can be displayed at a time, with higher-quality pickups like Bombs, Keys and Soul Hearts having priority on the display.

name: Strawman
description:
+1 Bomb.

Spawns Keeper as an extra controllable character alongside Isaac. The familiar will receive the same inputs as Isaac, but can be separated by holding down the "drop" button.

The Keeper will have his base stats, except speed which is shared between both characters. He won't receive any of his starting items.

The Keeper is able to pick up items on his own, thus having a separate inventory. He is not able, however, to pick up active items, trinkets, or consumables.

The Keeper's health is displayed over his head, and he can heal normally by picking up coins. Curse of the Unknown will hide his health bar.

Devil Room items will cost money instead of health while The Keeper is alive.

Placing a bomb will also make The Keeper place a bomb free of charge.

The Keeper is not able to walk through doors on his own, but he can enter the beams of light and the ending chest.

Unlocks for The Keeper cannot be earned by using this item.

When The Keeper dies, he spawns 5 Blue Spiders and the item is removed from Isaac's inventory. None of the items collected by The Keeper are dropped.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Keeper.

name: Dad's Note
description:
Initiates the Ascent sequence, teleporting Isaac to the backward floors, ultimately leading to the Home floor and The Beast fight.

The item cannot be rerolled or destroyed.

Can be acquired by entering the Strange Door that appears in the beginning of Depths II by using The Polaroid or The Negative on it. This will take Isaac to the Mausoleum/Gehenna, where the Boss Room will contain the item.

Has no effect if obtained outside the special Boss Room, except for the music slowly fading out.

name: Sausage
description:
+1 full Red Heart container.

+0.2 speed.

+0.5 damage.

+0.5 tears.

+2.5 range.

+0.2 shot speed.

+1 luck.

+6.9% for a Devil/Angel Room.

+6.9% Planetarium chance.

Fully heals Isaac.

name: Options?
description:
Makes 2 room clear rewards spawn instead of 1, but only one of them can be taken, while the other one disappears.

If one of the rewards is a Troll Bomb, picking up the other reward will not make the Troll Bomb disappear.

name: Candy Heart
description:
On pickupSpawns a Heart.

While heldGives Isaac one of the following stat boost per half heart healed by picking up Red Hearts or Rotten Hearts:

• +0.02 speed.

• +0.05 tears.

• +0.10 flat damage.

• +0.25 range.

• +0.02 shot speed.

• +0.10 luck.

Items that heal Isaac won't grant any boosts. Only hearts picked up off the ground count.

Does not work when adding to Tainted Bethany's blood charges.

name: A Pound of Flesh
description:
Items that require health to purchase now require money instead, and vice-versa.

Consumables in Shops no longer have a cost, but are instead surrounded by spikes that deal a full heart of damage. The pickups inside the spikes cannot be pushed by an explosion.

Buying Shop items for health does not prevent Angel Rooms from appearing.

Immunity from spikes does not prevent damage from the special spikes inside Shops. Invincibility frames or invulnerability from certain items will disallow Isaac from taking the pickups.

name: Redemption
description:
Makes a white inverted cross appear over Isaac's head upon entering a Devil Room. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the cross active, he will gain +1 Soul Heart and +1 damage.

Taking anything generated by the Devil Room will result in the icon going away. This includes both items, chests and pickups.

It is safe to pick up stuff that have been spawned after room generation, e.g. enemy drops or room clear rewards.

If a Red Chest generates an item, the item can be taken without the cross disappearing.

The item can be acquired from a Confessional or a Sacrifice Room after a devil deal has been taken.

name: Spirit Shackles
description:
Upon death, Isaac turns into a ghost linked to Isaac's dead body, and can continue fighting with 1/2 of a heart for 10 seconds, after which he comes back to life.

Isaac gains flight while in ghost form.

The effect cannot occur again until a half or full Soul Heart or Black Heart is picked up. Doing so will charge the item without adding to Isaac's health.

The Shackles appear blue when ready to be used, and grey when they aren't.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as The Forgotten.

name: Cracked Orb
description:
Taking damage activates the following effects:

• Unlocks all locked doors in the room. It can even unlock the Mega Satan door and the Strange Door in Depths II.

• Opens the Secret Room and Super Secret Room if adjacent to the current room.

• Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor. It can also reveal the Ultra Secret Room.

• Destroys all Tinted Rocks and rocks with a Crawl Space.

Cannot open Challenge Rooms from the outside, and regular rooms in the Chest or Dark Room.

Cannot open the door leading to Boss Rush or Blue Womb.

name: Empty Heart
description:
Adds an empty heart container at the beginning of each floor if Isaac has one red heart or less.

Does nothing with characters that cannot have red hearts.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating The Visage.

name: Astral Projection
description:
Taking damage for the first time in an uncleared room will stop time for 2 seconds, and turn Isaac into a ghost, leaving his body behind.

While in ghost form, Isaac gains flight, spectral tears, increased speed, and can shoot at a very fast rate, despite this not being shown on the HUD, as it's a result of time being slowed down.

Isaac will re-enter the body when the room is cleared, or if he takes damage, which will negate the damage.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Clutch.

name: C Section
description:
Replaces Isaac's tears with a short-delay charge attack that fires homing, piercing, spectral fetus-like tears. The charge attack fires on its own after fully charged.

Fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's damage, 3.75 times per second, until they run out of range.

Charge time depends on Isaac's fire rate: 30 / (RoundUp(TearDelay × 3) + 1). This cannot exceed 15.

The size of the fetuses scales with Isaac's damage.

Fetuses inherit Isaac's tear effects, and some special weapon effects, such as Mom's Knife or The Forgotten's bone club.

name: Lil Abaddon
description:
Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and creates a black ring after charging for 1 second.

The ring deals 3.5 damage per tick (52.5 per second), and lasts for 1 second.

synergies.description: ×2 damage and wider ring.

name: Montezuma's Revenge
description:
Continuously shooting for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a short-range brown Brimstone laser and corn shots behind him.

The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick, 15 times per second, and lasts for ~1.28 seconds.

Corn shots deal 6 damage, and a random amount of them are created with each blast.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Dangle.

name: Lil Portal
description:
Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and can be launched by double-tapping a shooting key.

The familiar will consume pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into Blue Flies while increasing its size.

Upon consuming 1 + 1 × CurrentFloor pickups, it will spawn a purple portal that leads to a special room. The contents of this room remain unchanged for the duration of the run, and it may be accessed from any floor by creating the portal again.

The portal remains in the same place it was initially created, even after Isaac leaves the room. Its location will be marked on the map.

After creating a portal, the familiar disappears until the next floor, where another portal can be created that leads back to the same room.

Damage dealt by the familiar is equal to 2 + 2 × ConsumablesDestroyed + 2 per tick, ticking up to 10 times per second. This damage cannot exceed 6.

The familiar does not deal damage or consume pickups while following behind Isaac. It must be launched in order to do so.

Any trapdoors created in the portal room will lead to the I AM ERROR room.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.

name: Worm Friend
description:
Spawns a familiar that burrows out of the ground and grabs enemies every 5 seconds, holding them in place for 5 seconds.

Grabbed enemies take 4 damage per tick (8 per second).

Also applies slowness on grabbed enemies, which affects their shots as well.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating The Stain.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.

name: Bone Spurs
description:
Enemies spawn 1-2 floating bones upon death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

Bones can block up to 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.

Bones deal damage equal to Isaac's damage in the moment they were created.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Carrion Queen.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.
Spawns a light grey locust that has a chance to shoot 2-3 bone projectiles upon impact with an enemy. Each bone projectile deals damage equal to the locust's damage.

name: Hungry Soul
description:
Grants enemies a 33% chance to spawn a friendly red ghost upon death, which chases down enemies and deals contact damage to them.

Ghosts deal damage equal to 50% of Isaac's damage (2x Isaac's damage per second).

The ghost explodes after 7 seconds, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times. This explosion cannot damage Isaac or the environment.

Enemies killed by ghosts won't spawn additional ghosts, except for those killed by the ghost's explosion.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as The Lost.

name: Jar of Wisps
description:
Spawns wisps that orbit Isaac, fire tears, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by Book of Virtues.

The Jar will initially spawn 2 wisps, but the amount is increased by +1 each time the jar is used, up to a total of 12 wisps. The amount of wisps the jar will spawn is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.

Every wisp spawned has a 15% chance of being of a special variant.

synergies.description: Amount of wisps spawned is doubled + 1.
Spawns Satanic Bible wisps that each add +10% Devil Room chance.

name: Soul Locket
description:
On pickupSpawns a Soul Heart.

While heldGives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart gained by picking up Soul Heart or Black Hearts off the ground:

• +0.04 speed.

• +0.1 tears.

• +0.2 flat damage.

• +0.5 range.

• +0.04 shot speed.

• +0.20 luck.

name: Friend Finder
description:
Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movement and attacks.

Can spawn the following monsters:

• Black Bony.

• Blaster.

• Bony.

• Chubber.

• Clot.

• Clotty.

• Coal Boy.

• Danny.

• Dople.

• Double Vis.

• Drowned Hive.

• Evil Twin.

• Grilled Clotty.

• Gurgle.

• Hive.

• Holy Bony.

• Holy Mulligan.

• I.Blob.

• Maw.

• Nest.

• Vis.

Certain enemies will have a crosshair that indicates where they're shooting.

Blasters will only fire by pressing the active item button.
unlock: Defeat The Beast as {{i|Jacob and Esau}}.

synergies.description: Spawns a random wisp.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Jacob and Esau.

name: Inner Child
description:
+1 Extra Life.

Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half a red heart (or half soul heart if he doesn't have any red heart containers), and receives:

+0.2 speed.

-50% size.

-73% hitbox size.

Respawning as the inner child emits a blood explosion that deals 35 damage to nearby enemies.

After unlocking, the item is guaranteed to spawn in the hidden closet in the Home floor once the tainted version of the current character has been unlocked.
unlock: Defeat Ultra Greed as {{i|Jacob and Esau}}.
unlock_text: Defeat Ultra Greed as Jacob and Esau.

name: Glitched Crown
description:
Causes newly generated item pedestals to indefinitely cycle between 5 random items from the current room's item pool, at a very quick rate of once every 0.2 seconds.

Does not affect quest items.

Also affects items during Curse of the Blind!, but none of the items can be seen.

Pausing the game will cause the items to cycle much faster.

synergies.description: Spawns a pink locust that has a chance to mimic random effects based on other Abyss locusts.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Isaac.

name: Belly Jelly
description:
Enemies and projectiles that touch Isaac have a 50% chance to bounce off of him and propel in the opposite direction. When this happens, damage to Isaac is negated.

Bounced off enemies will take damage upon hitting a wall or an obstacle, or another enemy. The damage is equal to 8 + 2 × CurrentFloor.

Only enemies that normally deal contact damage can be bounced off.

Bounced off projectiles deal 6 damage if they would deal half a heart of damage, or 7 if they would deal a full heart.

Lasers cannot be bounced off.

The bouncing mechanic also works for Fire Places and spikes enemies such as Poky, Slide and Grudge, granting a chance to avoid unintentional damage.

synergies.description: Spawns a blue locust that has a chance to punch enemies back.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Magdalene.

name: Sacred Orb
description:
Decreases the chances of low-quality items appearing by affecting newly created pedestals in the following way:

• Rerolls items with quality 0-1.

• Has a 33% chance to reroll items with quality 2.

Items with the quest tag cannot be rerolled.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Lost.

name: Sanguine Bond
description:
Spawns a special set of spikes in every Devil Room that deal a full heart of damage per use. Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to yield a reward:

• 35% - nothing.

• 33% - +0.5 damage.

• 15% - 6 pennies.

• 10% - 2 Black Hearts.

• 5% - random item from the Devil Room pool.

• 2% - Leviathan transformation.

The spikes will deal damage to enemies that walk or fly over them.

Causes all other spikes in the Devil Room to retract.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Judas.

name: The Swarm
description:
On pickupSpawns 8 orbital flies.

While heldEach time one of the flies blocks a projectile, it will turn into a Blue Fly.

An additional orbital fly is spawned upon clearing a room, up to a maximum of 16 at a time.

synergies.description: Spawns 3 cyan locust that are linked to each other, being 25% smaller, and have a chance to destroy enemy projectiles upon contact.

name: Heartbreak
description:
+3 Broken Hearts.

+0.25 damage for every Broken Heart Isaac has.

Causes every fatal hit to add 2 more Broken Hearts instead of killing Isaac, and deal 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

This effect won't prevent death from Devil Deals.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Eve.

name: Bloody Gust
description:
When Isaac takes damage, he gains stat boosts for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of 6 times per floor:

• +0.04 × HitsTaken + 0.07 speed

• +0.1 × HitsTaken + 0.25 fire rate

name: Salvation
description:
Creates an angelic halo around Isaac that, when an enemy comes in contact with, a beam of light starts forming above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing damage to them and creating 4 more beams in the cardinal directions.

The initial beam does 3.5 damage per tick, up to 15 times, and the others deal 1.75 per second, up to 15 times.

The halo will grow in size each time Isaac takes damage, up to a maximum of 10 times. The size resets after leaving the floor.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Lazarus.

name: Vanishing Twin
description:
Spawns a fetus familiar that follows Isaac.

After entering a Boss Room, the familiar will move to the center of the room, and transform into a clone of the boss. Isaac must defeat both bosses in order to proceed.

When this happens, both the original boss and its copy will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and will gain slightly reduced movement and attack speed.

Upon dying, the clone will drop an item from the Boss item pool, even before the fight is over. The original boss will also grant another item.

The cloning can happen only once per floor.

The familiar cannot clone mini-bosses and final bosses such as Mom, Mom's Heart, Isaac, Satan, etc.

The familiar can clone the boss even after it's been defeated.

On floors with multiple boss rooms, the familiar will act only on the first boss encountered.

If it clones Great Gideon, 2 extra waves of enemies are added to the battle.

The item is removed from item pools and cannot be found normally starting from Chapter 4.

The item has no effect in Greed Mode.
unlock_text: Defeat Hush as Jacob and Esau.

name: Twisted Pair
description:
Spawns 2 familiars that float by the left and right side of Isaac, and fire tears alongside him that copy his stats and tear effects.

Each familiar deals 37.5% of Isaac's damage. When playing as Lilith or Tainted Lilith, they instead deal 50% damage each.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.
Spawns 2 red locusts that are linked to each other.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Lilith.

name: Azazel's Rage
description:
Upon clearing a room, Isaac builds up rage that is indicated by the patch of skin spreading around his face, as well as 4 sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.

After clearing 4 rooms, Isaac's head will flash red. Upon entering room with enemies, a large Brimstone laser is fired for ~3.33 seconds, that deals Isaac's damage per tick, 15 times per second.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Azazel.

name: Echo Chamber
pickup_quote: I can see see the future future future
description:
When Isaac uses a consumable (card, pill, rune, soul stone, etc), he also uses a copy of the 3 previous consumables used after picking up Echo Chamber.

Consumables used with mimic items, such as Blank Card, Placebo or Clear Rune, won't get added to the queue.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Apollyon.

name: Isaac's Tomb
description:
Makes an Old Chest appear at the start of each floor.

The chest won't spawn on the Home floor.
unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Forgotten.

name: Vengeful Spirit
description:
Upon taking damage, spawns an invulnerable red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage, but does not block projectiles.

Wisps are destroyed when leaving the floor. Up to 6 wisps can be created per floor.

Wisps' tears are shot once per second, and deal damage equal to 2.9 + 0.1 × CurrentFloor.

Contact damage is equal to 50% of Isaac's damage per tick, and is dealt 15 times per second.

synergies.description: ×2 contact and on-hit damage.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Bethany.

name: Esau Jr.
description:
Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., a separate character that has 3 Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight.

Coins, bombs, and keys are shared between the 2 characters, but a separate inventory exists for everything else (health, items, consumables, trinkets).

When used for the first time, Esau Jr. receives random items equal to the number of items the original characters has. Each item is chosen from the same item pool as the original item. Only passive items are given substitutes. Items with the quest tag and set drops (such as The Small Rock) are not counted and won't get a substitute item.

If either character dies, they will both die.

Esau Jr. will receive any passive starting item the original character had, however, if said items are rerollable, they will count towards the number of items he should get, resulting in both the staring item and 1 extra to be obtained.

Using 5 different copies of Esau Jr. one after the other, starting from the 5th copy, Esau Jr.'s jar will break and create a familiar that behaves like Abel, and deals 7.5 damage per shot but at a faster fire rate.

synergies.description: Spawns a black wisp when turning into Esau Jr. Turning back into the original character destroys the wisp.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Jacob.

name: Berserk!
type_label: Active item (recharge by dealing damage to enemies)
description:
+0.4 speed.

+3 flat damage.

+2 fire rate.

×0.5 fire rate multiplier.

Replaces Isaac's tears with a jaw bone similar to The Forgotten's club. It also uses the same synergies as the club.

This effect lasts for 5 seconds.

The jaw bone deals 3x Isaac's damage when swung, and 1.5x Isaac's damage when thrown.

Swinging the jaw bone will reflect enemy shots, and is able to pick up pickups from a distance.

Killing an enemy while in Berserk mode will increase the duration of the effect by 1 second, and grant very brief invincibility that prevents damage from exploding enemies. Duration cannot be increased by more than 5 seconds.

Each enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.

Isaac is unable to die while in Berserk mode. His health can go down to 0, but he will not die until the effect ends. During this time, he can heal himself and cheat death.

The item starts at 50% charge when picked up. It is charged by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms or picking up batteries. To fully charge it, Isaac must deal damage equal to 120 + 40 × CurrentFloor.

synergies.description: Spawns a pale wisp in the middle ring that has increased HP but doesn't shoot.

name: Dark Arts
type_label:
Active item (6 seconds recharge time)
(1 second cooldown)
description:
+1 speed.

Allows Isaac to walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second, or until he shoots. Walking through them will freeze them until the effect ends, then deal damage to them equal to 2 × DamageStat + 3.5. If multiple enemies/projectiles get caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional 3.5 damage.

At the end of the effect, an area of blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or projectiles were pierced during the effect.

When used as Black Judas or Tainted Judas, they will gain a temporary +1 damage bonus for every enemy/projectile walked through, that wears off at a rate of -0.25 every half a second.

During the effect, Isaac is unable to collect pickups or use machines/beggars.

The effect can be used to walk freely through Curse Rooms and walk over spikes, or open Spiked Chests.

Invulnerable enemies will still grant bonuses even if they cannot be damaged.

synergies.description: Spawns black wisps in the middle ring whenever an enemy is killed with Dark Arts. These wisps do not persist between rooms.
Grants temporary damage up for every enemy/projectile hit by Dark Arts.

name: Abyss
description:
Consumes all item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust familiar for each item consumed.

The locusts are permanent once created, and up to 64 can exists at a time. Consuming more items after this number will replace older locusts. This limit is shared with Blue Flies and Blue Spiders.

The locusts loosely follow Isaac similarly to Blue Flies, and charge in the direction he's firing until they hit an enemy, wall, or obstacle.

Locusts deal various damage 4.29 times per second, based on the consumed item's quality, and have a different size multiplier:

• Quality 0: 0.5x Isaac's damage, 0.8x size.

• Quality 1: 0.75x Isaac's damage, 0.9x size.

• Quality 2: 1x Isaac's damage, 1x size.

• Quality 3: 1.5x Isaac's damage, 1.1x size.

• Quality 4: 2x Isaac's damage, 1.2x size.

Some items, when consumed, will produce a unique locust with different behavior. Check the respective item pages to see if Abyss would create such a locust.

If at the limit of 64 locusts and multiple item pedestals are present in the room, Abyss will only consume half of the items.

Items can be consumed while the pick-up animation is playing, i.e. Isaac is holding the item above his head.

Absorbing items counts as Isaac taking them, thus will activate Boss Rush, Challenge Rooms, and similar mechanics.

If Abyss is used in a room with linked choice item pedestals, only one of them will be absorbed, while the others will vanish as if Isaac took them.

synergies.description: +25% damage.
Spawns a black-glowing fly wisp with 10 HP that doesn't fire any tears.

Spawns 16 different locusts:

• Yellow: 30% chance to explode.

• Blue: chance to punch enemies.

• Pink: chance for a random effect.

• Light grey: chance to shoot 2-3 bone projectiles.

• Cyan: chance to destroy enemy projectiles.

• Orange: chance to set enemies on fire.

• Grey: chance to magnetize enemies.

• Electrical cyan: chance to chain-zap enemies.

• Green: chance to poison enemies.

• White: has a Godhead aura.

• Black: chance to apply fear.

• Light grey: chance to slow enemies.

• Dark red: chance to apply bleed.

• Grey: chance to confuse enemies.

• White: chance to summon a Crack the Sky beam.

• Purple: homes in on enemies.

name: Supper
description:
+1 full Red Heart container.

Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

name: Stapler
description:
+1 damage.

Prevents Isaac from firing tears from his left eye.

name: Suplex!
description:
Causes Isaac to dash a short distance. If he runs into an enemy while dashing, he will pick them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with the shooting buttons.

After 1 second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on. This also creates a circular wave of rocks that damages nearby enemies and destroys projectiles.

Isaac is invulnerable while dashing and holding an enemy, except to damage from Blood Donation Machines and Devil Beggars.

The damage of the slam is equal to 50 ± S, where S is the number of size ups/downs Isaac has.

Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the wave scales with Isaac's size.

Isaac can also Suplex bombs, bosses, shopkeepers, TNT, stone enemies, fire places, furniture in the Home level, etc.

synergies.description: Spawns 3 wisps where Isaac landed. The wisps rotate around the spot and fire tears in the same direction as Isaac. The wisps don't persist between rooms.

unlock_text: Defeat Delirium as Jacob and Esau.

name: Bag of Crafting
description:
Upon use, pressing an attack button will cause a swipe attack that deals 3 damage to enemies and knocks them back. The size of the swipe scales with Isaac's size, and is affected by his range.

The swipe can be used to open chests and block projectiles.

Swiping a pickup off the floor will add it to the bag. Up to 8 pickups can be stored in the bag. These pickups cannot be dropped.

Double pickups will add 2 copies of the pickup into the bag.

Pickups can also be collected from the Shop, if Isaac has enough money to buy them first.

Once 8 pickups have been collected, the bag can be used once more to create an item based on the types of pickups (components) collected.

A random recipe is chosen for each item when the run starts. This is seeded per run.

If the bag would grant an item that hasn't been unlocked yet, a random item will be crafted instead.

Some recipes are fixed and exist in every run. Check the GuruWiki page for a full list of fixed recipes.

The crafted item is chosen from one of the following pools:

• 40% → Boss

• 40% → Shop

• 20% → Treasure Room

Pickups added into the bag have different qualities. Some pickups grant a chance to craft an item from a different pool. Check the GuruWiki page for more details.

Based on the overall quality of all components in the bag, the crafted item can be chosen from a special pool (Angel Room, Devil Room, or Secret Room), or other pools based on previously explained criteria.

The overall quality of components in the bag also affects the crafted item's possible quality.
Special poolOther poolItem quality
40+35+4
32-3927-343-4

When playing as Tainted Cain

The item that would be crafted is displayed in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

Getting more than 8 pickups in the bag will shift its contents left and up, deleting the top-left slot and adding to the bottom-right.

Tapping the drop key will cycle the bag's contents left and up in a loop. Holding the use button will craft the displayed item.

Crafting an active item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups, just like collecting it would.

Curse of the Blind! will hide the crafting preview.

synergies.description: Spawns a random wisp upon crafting an item.
Collecting Red Hearts, Half Red Hearts or Double Hearts with the item has a 12.5% chance to transform them into Black Hearts, which is indicated with a special sound and black smoke puff.

name: Flip
type_label: Active item (6 rooms recharge time; 4 as Tainted Lazarus)
description:
While heldWhen Isaac enters a room containing an item, the item pedestal will appear with a secondary ghostly item behind it.

Only the real item can be interacted with. The ghostly one will vanish if Isaac leaves the room and there is no real item on the pedestal.

Item pedestals that are spawned after room generation, e.g. Boss Room items, items from chests, etc., won't have a ghostly item.

Buying an item from a Shop or Devil Deal will also buy the ghostly version of it for free.

On useCycles between the real and ghostly items on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly variant.

Does not affect pedestals that don't have a ghostly item on them.

If playing as Tainted Lazarus, it will switch between the dead and alive form of the character, and the item will have only 4 charges rather than 6.

synergies.description: Spawns a small white Isaac head wisp.

name: Lemegeton
description:
Grants an orbital wisp that takes the form of a random passive item.

The summoned item will act as if Isaac owns it, but is active only while the wisp is alive.

The item has a 25% chance to be chosen from the current room's item pool, otherwise a random pool is selected.

Only items with the summonable tag can be generated.

The wisps can block up to 4 shots and/or get hit by 2 explosions before destroyed.

Wisps deals contact damage equal to 2x Isaac's damage per tick, 2 times per second. They also receive contact damage.

A total of 24 wisps can be created. Using the item when this limit is reached will replace the oldest wisp.

Item wisps do not exhaust item pools, meaning Isaac can still normally find these items in a run, and multiple of the same item wisp can be obtained.

Wisps do not contribute towards transformations, or the Collection Page.

Items that would normally grant pickups or health, will not do so when summoned as wisps.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.
Causes Lemegeton's wisps to shoot homing tears alongisde Isaac that deal 3 damage.

name: Sumptorium
type_label:
Active item (10 seconds recharge time)
(2 seconds cooldown)
description:
When used by any character other than Tainted Eve
Removes half a heart of health and creates a blood clot familiar.

Blood clots mimic Isaac's movement, shooting, and inherit tear, effect, including weapon effects.

Holding down the drop button allows Isaac to move independently from the clots.

The familiar start with 15 HP that slowly decays down to 1 HP over time, or 5 HP for clots created by non-red hearts.

Clots are immune to hazards such as spikes, fire places, and lasers.

Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage when they hit them.

Isaac's bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.

Each type of heart generates a unique type of blood clot, however red hearts are prioritized when using the item:

• Red Heart: 35% damage.

• Soul Heart: 35% damage; 22.5 HP.

• Black Heart: 43% damage; Dark Matter tears.

• Eternal Heart: 52% damage; Sacred Heart tears.

• Golden Heart: 35% damage; Midas' Touch tears (scales with luck).

• Bone Heart: 35% damage; Compound Fracture tears.

• Rotten Heart: 35% damage; 7.5 HP.

When playing as Tainted Eve
Holding down the fire button will create blood clot familiars every 2 seconds and drain half a heart.

Activating the item will recall all previously created blood clots and heal Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts used to generate the clots.

Blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through when returned to her.

If more blood clots get returned that the amount of health she can have, excess blood clots will drop next to her.

The item has a recharge time of 1 second instead of 10.

A maximum of 29 clots can be absorbed at once.

synergies.description: ×2 damage.

When playing as Tainted Eve, it spawns red wisps for every clot consumed. They disappear once she starts creating clots again.

No effect on other characters.

name: Recall
type_label:
Active item (3 seconds recharge time)
(5 seconds cooldown)
description:
Only has an effect when playing as Tainted Forgotten, and can only be obtained via his Birthright.

Retreives The Forgotten's body automatically, even from a distance.

Tainted Soul is invincible while the body is returning to him, except to forms of self-damage such as Devil Beggars.

Tainted Forgotten will deal ~4-6x Isaac's damage to enemies that collide with it while it's returning to the Soul.

The item cannot be used while the Soul is holding the body or the body is traveling after it has been thrown.

name: Hold
description:
Only has an effect when playing as Tainted ???.

Removes Tainted ???'s leftmost poop, storing it inside of the jar and cycling to the next poop.

Using Hold while a poop is inside it will remove the poop and use it as expected.

name: Keeper's Sack
description:
On pickupSpawns 3 random coins and 1 Key.

While heldGrants stat upgrades for each item/pickup purchased with money. It can give the following upgrades:

• +0.5 damage.

• +0.25 range.

• +0.03 speed.

Every 3¢ spent in a shop will give boosts to a specific stat, going in the order of damage -> range -> speed.

Buying 15¢ items gives the same amount of stats as buying 5 3¢ items.

name: Keeper's Kin
description:
While in a room with enemies, rocks and obstacles will occasionally spawn Blue Spiders.

Causes 0-2 Blue Spiders to spawn when destroying a rock.

name: Keeper's Box
description:
Spawns a random Shop pickup or item that must be bought for its normal shop price. The item will be chosen from the Shop item pool.

Has an equal ~11.1% chance to spawn a card, pill, bomb, key, battery, item, soul heart, red heart, or a grab bag.

If used inside of a Devil Room, pickups will be surrounded by spikes that damage Isaac for a full heart, and items will cost hearts.

synergies.description: Spawns glowing coin wisps in the middle ring. Enemies killed by these wisps have a 20% chance to drop a penny.

name: Everything Jar
type_label: Active item (12 rooms recharge time; can be used with any charge)
description:
Spawns a different pickup based on the number of charges the item had when used:

• 1: poop.

• 2: Penny.

• 3: Bomb.

• 4: Key.

• 5: Heart.

• 6: pill.

• 7: card, rune, or soul stone.

• 8: Soul Heart.

• 9: Gold Heart.

• 10: Golden Key.

• 11: Golden Bomb.

If the item was fully charged, it instead does one of the following:

• Spawns a random amount of various pickups.

• Spawns a neutral fly.

• Spawns a bunch of friendly Dips, Blue Flies, and Blue Spiders.

• Closes the room's doors and spawns random enemies in front of each door, including Secret Room entrances.

• Spawns an item pedestal that cycles between 9 different items, 30 times per second, Items are selected from the current room's item pool.

• Spawns many different colored beams of light that deal damage to enemies and scale with Isaac's damage.

• Fills the room with poop.

• Spawns 6 Troll Bombs.

• Invokes the effects of Dataminer.

• Spawns a bunch of Shopkeepers.

• Spawns a Giga Bomb pickup that has a chance to be lit and explode.

• Does nothing.

synergies.description: Spawns a random wisp.

name: TMTRAINER
pickup_quote: Isaac and his mother lived alone in a small house on a hill
description:
On pickupPetrifies all enemies in the room and sets them on fire.

Fades out the music, making it silent until another music track starts playing.

While heldCauses all future items to become glitched, causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items, as well as effects that are not normally controlled by Isaac, such as enemy spawns.

Item sprites are also combined from other item sprites, often appearing in different colors.

This does not apply to quest items.

Glitched items can be either active or passive. There is a 75% chance for them to be passive.

Random effects can be assigned on random events, such as upon taking damage, enemy death, room clear, etc.

Glitched items will have random prices in shops.

synergies.description: Glitched active items spawn random wisps.
Spawns a pink locust that mimics random effects based on other Abyss locusts.

unlock_text: Defeat The Beast as Tainted Eden.

name: Anima Sola
description:
Chains down the nearest enemy, completely preventing them from acting for 5 seconds.

Using the item again, even if not fully charged, will release the enemy immediately.

The effect also works on enemies that are invulnerable.

When playing as Tainted Jacob
The chain will always be set on Dark Esau, if he is present. Releasing Dark Esau will immediately cause him to charge at Tainted Jacob.

Dark Esau deals no contact damage to Jacob while chained down.

If used in a room without any enemies before Dark Esau has spawned, it will immediately summon him without wasting a charge.

synergies.description: Spawns a dark wisp that orbits the locked enemy and shoots at them. The wisp dies when the enemy does.

name: Spindown Dice
description:
Rerolls all items in the current room by subtracting their internal ID number by 1 until a valid item is rolled.

Locked items and items with the hidden tag are skipped.

To check which item is next in the reroll queue, see the item left from the desired item in the item list.

Items that are generated via this type of reroll are not removed from item pools and can be found again during the run, unless picked up.

synergies.description: Spawns an extra wisp and rerolls all of Isaac's wisps into the same type of wisp.

name: Hypercoagulation
description:
Taking damage or donating health makes a red heart launch out of Isaac that disappears after 1.5 seconds.

The heart depends on the amount of health spent: half heart spent will produce half a heart, while a full heart will produce a full heart.

Damage sources that scale up from half a heart to a full heart, starting from Chapter 4, will still only produce half a heart.

No hearts are spawned when spending heart containers in Devil Deals.

name: IBS
description:
After dealing enough damage to enemies, Isaac begins to flash red. Once this happens, releasing the fire button activates one of Tainted ???'s unique poop abilities.

IBS cannot activate if Isaac is currently holding a poop.

name: Hemoptysis
description:
Double-tapping a fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood that deals damage to enemies in front of him and knocks back pickups, enemies and projectiles.

The amount of damage the sneeze does is equal to 1.5x Isaac's damage.

Enemies knocked back take 8 + 2 × CurrentFloor damage if they hit a wall or an obstacle, and deal the same damage to other enemies they hit.

The sneeze has a cooldown period of 1 second.

The sneeze applies a Brimstone curse to enemies for 5 seconds which makes them take more damage from Brimstone-like laser beams and explode on death from such an attack, damaging and spreading the curse to nearby enemies.

The amount of damage cursed enemies receive from lasers is equal to 2 × DamageStat + 3. This damage also applies to lasers shot by enemies.

The range of the sneeze attack is affected by Isaac's shot speed.

name: Ghost Bombs
description:
+5 Bombs.

Causes Isaac's bombs to create ghosts when they explode, that rapidly chase and deal contact damage to enemies equal to 50% of Isaac's damage per tick, 3.75 times per second.

Ghosts explode after 10 seconds, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3 times, and destroying enemy projectiles. Isaac and the environment are immune to the explosion.

synergies.description: Spawns a yellow locust that has a 50% chance to explode upon enemy contact, dealing 40 damage.

name: Gello
description:
Spawns a familiar that's attached to Isaac, and can be controlled in the direction Isaac is shooting. While Isaac is shooting, the familiar will shoot at the closest enemy.

The familiar inherits Isaac's damage, tears, range, shoot speed, tear effects, and tear modifiers.

Launching the familiar deals 3x Isaac's damage to enemies it hits.

Gello's tears deal 75% of Isaac's damage, or 100% if playing as Lilith or Tainted Lilith.

synergies.description: ×2 tear damage.
Spawns a red wisp in the middle ring that orbits Gello instead of Isaac.

name: Decap Attack
description:
Throws Isaac's head, allowing him to shoot from the spot it lands. The head will block enemy shots and deal contact damage. The body cannot shoot tears while the head is detached.

The head does 24 damage on impact and 4 damage per tick (12 per second) while on the ground.

The head can return to Isaac by touching it, or by using the item again which won't waste charges. Both throwing and retaking the head deals 24 damage to enemies passing through.

Has a 1% chance of being dropped upon defeating Chimera.

synergies.description: ×2 contact damage.
Spawns a stationary wisp where Isaac was standing when he threw his head. The wisp shoots in Isaac's direction and does not persist between rooms.

+2 damage.

x3 tears.

These stats apply only while the head is detached from the body.

name: Glass Eye
description:
+0.75 damage.

+1 luck.

name: Stye
description:

name: G FUEL!
description:
This is a promotional item that can appear only during special daily runs, or by activating the secret easter egg seed GFVE LLLL.

Modifies Isaac's tears by replacing them with various guns, also affecting his stats. The effects of the item change based on how many copies of it have been acquired.

Each copy of the item grants +0.2 speed that breaks the normal speed cap of 2.0.

The item appears in the starting room of each floor. During Curse of the Labyrinth!, 2 copies of the item will appear.

Every explosion effect is replaced with stock explosion footage and sound effects.

Makes enemies explode on death. The explosion is purely cosmetic and does not deal additional damage.

All consumable spawn animations are accompanied by explosion sprites as well.

Enemies grant far more score on death than usual. The amount of score is displayed when they die.

Water and blood in rooms is replaced with a light blue liquid.

Pressing the drop button plays an airhorn sound effect.

Most special floor tiles are replaced with G Fuel ones.

Replaces Isaac's nightmares during floor transition with unique G Fuel-themed versions.
